### Common Model Updates


- [Samsara](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/samsara) now sets[Vehicle](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle)` fuelType` to` electric` when EV telemetry is available
- [AI ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/ai-eld) ,[ProLogs](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/prologs) , and[Synergy ELD](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/synergy-eld) now include normalized[Driver](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/driver)` phone` and` license` fields when available


### Integration Updates


- [Teletrac Navman 360](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/teletrac-navman-360) now supports UK-region accounts
- [Dreyev](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/dreyev) now supports[IFTA Vehicle Month](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/ifta-summary) and[Camera Media](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/camera-media)
- [Dreyev](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/dreyev) now maps additional safety signals, including support for` stop_sign_violation` and refined` near_crash` classification
- [JJ Keller](https://docs.withterminal.com/providers/tsp/jj-keller) now includes` truck` and` pickup` units in synced[Vehicles](https://docs.withterminal.com/models/vehicle)


### API Updates


- Added the` link.analytics_event_emitted` webhook so you can receive Link funnel analytics events, including connection completion signals
